story.label: N° 002 - Brand Story
story.title:
A modern
*Indian*
escape.
story.lead: The Indian Lab was created to redefine how Indian cuisine is experienced in Victoria: rooted in memory, refined for the present, and served in a room built for lingering.
story.body: Our kitchen honours regional Indian recipes while elevating them through modern technique, careful presentation, and premium ingredients. Around the table, soft lighting, curated house music, elegant interiors, and a vibrant patio create an evening that feels intimate, global, and deeply connected to India.
story.pullquote: Authentic at heart, modern in expression, and designed around how a guest feels from the first note to the final sip.

studies.title:

*refined*
for tonight.
studies.body: Signature plates move from the tandoor to the coast, from slow-cooked comfort to elegant modern finishes.

cocktails.label: N° 004 — The Bar Program
cocktails.title:
Cocktails, *wine*,
and slow rhythm.
cocktails.body: The bar brings Indian botanicals into a polished global language: tamarind, cardamom, saffron, smoke, premium spirits, and cellar selections from around the world.
cocktails.feature_note: A bitter-sweet house Negroni rounded with date-tamarind cordial and a clean cardamom finish.
cocktails.feature_method: Stirred · Served on a single rock

ambience.label: N° 006 — Ambience
ambience.title:
A room
lit for *romance*
and rhythm.
ambience.body: Warm tones, soft lighting, intimate seating, polished textures, and a soundtrack of carefully curated house music. Outside, the patio carries the same elevated mood into the Victoria evening.
ambience.interior_caption: Elegant textures, low light, and intimate tables designed for dates, celebrations, and slow conversation.
ambience.patio_caption: A vibrant open-air setting with refined service, warm details, and an easy West Coast glow.
ambience.music_caption: House music selected with restraint, giving the room energy without taking it over.

visit.title:

in *Victoria*.
visit.lead: 2401 Millstream Rd #193 in Langford. Fine Indian dining, a crafted cocktail bar, a premium wine cellar, and a patio made for lingering.

about_page.lead: The Indian Lab is a refined dining room in Victoria shaped by friendship, hospitality, and a shared love for Indian cuisine reimagined with global confidence.
